args.query:
SELECT h.category, SUM(vm_count) AS completions
FROM (
  SELECT habit_id, COUNT(*) AS vm_count
  FROM fct_value_moments
  GROUP BY habit_id
) vm
JOIN dim_habit h USING (habit_id)
GROUP BY h.category
ORDER BY completions DESC;
